issuingAuthority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) & CPCB

categories.name: Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs)

environmentalDamage: Acidic effluent dumped into municipal drains

categories.formalRecyclerProcess: Closed-loop hydrometallurgical extraction with wet scrubber off-gas treatment (>98% precious metal recovery).

categories.name: Lithium-Ion & Lead Acid Batteries

practices: Manual chisel hammering to expose cells
humanHealthImpacts: Spontaneous explosive fire and thermal burns
environmentalDamage: Heavy metal leaching into agricultural soil

categories.formalRecyclerProcess: Inert nitrogen shredding, electrolyte recovery, followed by hydrometallurgical black mass separation into battery-grade sulfates.

categories.name: CRT Glass, Displays & Monitors
hazardousConstituents: Mercury (Hg) lamps in older LCD backlights

practices: Smashing screens with hammers to extract copper yoke
humanHealthImpacts: Silicosis & lung damage from lead dust
environmentalDamage: Leaded micro-glass shards contaminate soil for centuries

categories.formalRecyclerProcess: Diamond wire cutting to separate panel from funnel glass, thermal cleaning, glass-to-glass recycling or lead smelting in blast furnaces with baghouse filters.
categories.informalRecoveryYield: Only copper yoke salvage (10-15% of total value; all Indium and CRT glass wasted)

categories.name: Copper Cables, Wiring & Harnesses

practices: Open burning in pits using kerosene or tires to melt insulation
humanHealthImpacts: Inhalation of polychlorinated dibenzo-p-dioxins and furans (carcinogens)
environmentalDamage: Black toxic soot releases PM2.5 and volatile organic compounds (VOCs)

categories.formalRecyclerProcess: Dry mechanical stripping, cryogenic wire granulation, and pneumatic density air-table separation yielding 99.9% clean copper granules and recyclable PVC pellets.
categories.informalRecoveryYield: 65% (35% copper oxidized or melted into ash)

categories.name: Rare Earth Magnets, Motors & Compressors

practices: Angle grinder chopping of hermetic compressors
Discarding permanent magnets as black iron
environmentalDamage: Refrigerant release depletes ozone and aggravates global warming

categories.formalRecyclerProcess: Automated degasification, oil vacuum recovery, followed by hydrogen decrepitation for rare earth magnet recovery (NdFeB).
categories.informalRecoveryYield: 0% rare earth recovery (magnets dumped as base iron; 50% value lost)
